name.full: AI Workflow Gallery for Copilot Cowork

description.short: Find, follow and contribute reusable AI tasks, workflows and methods
description.full: Teaches Copilot Cowork to use the AI Workflow Gallery through an authorized browser. Public collections are read-only; enabled Playground authoring is shared and disposable. Private deployment access depends on your own sign-in and organizational policy. This skills-only package contains no connector or credentials and does not grant gallery access.
